scope: diagnosis of previously evaluated pairs, not new blind evidence or model tuning
threshold_policy: reuse baseline validation-frozen threshold exactly; never recalibrate
input_policy: same config, models, manifests and all pairs; fail if scored records differ from baseline
image_counting: unique decoded image per split; no duplicate counting from genuine/impostor reuse
failure_policy: first observed terminal stage; quality reason counts may overlap; no downstream inference after rejection
grouping: connected components of shared subject IDs across genuine and impostor pairs
limitations: known test reuse; no session-independence claim
no causal glasses effect or low-FAR guarantee
no source image, embedding, source subject name, or local path in outputs
